{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(sales.head().to_string())

# Display data types and missing values
print(sales.info())

# Check unique values in 'customer_type' column
print('\nUnique values in customer_type:')
print(sales['customer_type'].unique())

# Check unique values in 'order_status' column
print('\nUnique values in order_status:')
print(sales['order_status'].unique())

# Check if 'revenue' column exists and its dtype
print('\nRevenue column dtype:')
print(sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for any missing values in key columns
print('\nMissing values in key columns:')
print(sales[['customer_type', 'order_status', 'revenue']].isnull().sum())"}
